born.why: The code prioritizes carrying known-safe keys for efficiency, eating known-safe smells, and leaving poisonous ones, while using tasting only as a necessary risk when starving to expand knowledge of safe foods.

The code prioritizes survival by eating risky unknowns only when starvation is imminent, uses a single confirmed safe history to reliably eat known good fruits, and avoids potentially poisonous ones unless necessary for data gathering or survival, thus balancing safety and energy acquisition.

The code improves by using trait-based heuristics (color, shape) to safely exploit unknown fruits when sufficient positive evidence exists, reducing unnecessary tasting risks while maintaining starvation safety overrides and known poison avoidance.

The code prioritizes safety by eating only fully verified safe fruits or targets, uses taste to gather data on novel/ambiguous fruits unless starving, and avoids known harmful species unless life-threatening hunger forces a risk.

The code prioritizes safety by avoiding confirmed poisonous fruits, uses past success to efficiently carry known good food, and balances survival hunger against cautious tasting to maximize long-term intake while minimizing poison risk.

This code prioritizes avoiding known poisonous traits via history filtering, uses tasting to verify safety when uncertainty is high or hunger changes significantly, and switches between eating (for immediate survival) and carrying (for pantry storage) based on current hunger levels.

The code prioritizes survival by avoiding known poisonous fruits unless starving, uses cautious tasting for unknown species to gather data safely, and optimizes energy management by eating when hungry and carrying to pantry when not, thereby increasing long-term lifespan and dietary variety.

The code prioritizes survival by eating anything when critical starvation occurs, avoids known poisonous species permanently, eats known safe foods immediately, and cautiously tastes new species only when hunger allows, using historical data to minimize risk.
